navigation_notes: Village Parkway runs along the south side of campus; Brighton Drive runs along the east side; the Iron Horse Trail runs along the north-west edge.
GAEL Stadium (football field/track) and the baseball/softball diamonds are in the north-west corner of campus, closest to the Iron Horse Trail.
The Sports Complex, Building F (Science & Engineering / ARC), and Parking Lots 5-6 are north-center of campus, along Brighton Drive.
Building E (Auxiliary Gym), Building C (VAPA) with the attached Performing Arts Center, the tennis courts, and the portables are west-center of campus.
Admin, the Library, the Amphitheater, the Student Union, and Building H cluster around the central plaza.
Buildings J and K are north-east along Brighton Drive; Buildings L, M, and N are south-east along Brighton Drive, closest to the Village Parkway corner.
Parking Lots 1-4 run along the south edge (Village Parkway); Lots 5-6 are along the north-east edge (Brighton Drive).
